ChatMessage.description: One chat message row: selection mode, avatars, forward/reply chrome, bubble (body, attachments or link preview), edited/time/read footer; mobile swipe-to-reply. Props extend Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'|'onContextMenu'>.

onContextMenu.type: (e: React.MouseEvent, copyType: string | null, externalProps?: Record<string, unknown>) => void

ChatNameInput.description: Group chat name + optional single avatar file, validation, Cancel/Continue; Enter submits same as Continue. Props extend Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

AdditionalMessages.description: Reply/edit/forward strip with optional attachment thumb and close; returns null if message.error. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

AttachModal.description: Modal: attachments list + textarea + send/cancel/add-more; states isSending/isPending. Rest to Modal. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'|'onInput'|'onKeyDown'>.

ContextMenu.description: Absolute positioned menu (role=menu) at x/y; children are menu items. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'> with required children.

ConversationHeader.description: Chat header: tabs, selection toolbar, close/back, context menu, open info. Status: TypingLine, or DM online/recent_activity via useOpponentByCid + getLastVisitTime, or group member count. Adapters: useParticipants, useOpponentByCid, useMessages, useContextMenu, userUtils.

ConversationInfo.description: Conversation details section: participants, edit/add actions, profile/context hooks. Root as=section. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'section'>, 'as'|'children'>.

MessageStatus.description: Sent/read/clock icon in a span via WrapperRoot; status or message.status. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'span'>, 'as'|'children'>.

DotsLoader.description: Inline ThreeDots spinner (react-loader-spinner); width/height/color props only.

ConversationInput.description: Composer around MessageInput; requires getAdapters (drafts/messages/conversations). Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

ConversationItemList.description: Conversation list + CustomVerticalScrollbar; optional scroll_pos localStorage. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

ConversationSelectModal.description: Modal with title, close, optional topContent, CustomVerticalScrollbar body.

CustomVerticalScrollbar.description: Custom scrollbar + optional scroll-to-bottom, localStorage scroll_pos_*, autoHeight. Standalone props (no WrapperRoot).

MediaAttachments.description: Grid of MediaAttachment tiles; custom onContextMenu per file. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'|'onContextMenu'>.

MediaViewer.description: Full-screen media carousel; index, close, optional getFileType and mobile. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

getFileType.type: (fileName?: string | null, fileContentType?: string | null) => string | null

Modal.description: Centered dialog; overlay className + onClick only from WrapperRoot props in implementation. Extends WrapperRootProps<'div'> minus as/children plus panelClassName, contentKey, tall.

OvalLoader.description: Oval SVG loader; width/height/color. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

ContextMenuItem.description: Menu row with text, icon, onClick; uId/uObject app-only. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

ConversationItem.description: Single conversation list row. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>.

SearchBlock.description: Search users/chats with adapter or props data; CustomVerticalScrollbar; selection modes. Standalone props (no WrapperRoot on type).

SearchConversationList.description: Conversation picker list with optional title and empty message.

SearchInput.description: Controlled search: value + onChange(string). Wrapper role=search, input type=search, clear button when non-empty. Click wrapper focuses input. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'|'onChange'>.

TextAreaInput.description: Plain textarea with ref and event handlers; no WrapperRoot.

UserProfile.description: Current user profile; adapters; shareRef unused in implementation.

UserSelectorBlock.description: Create/add participants UI with search slots and maxCount.

SummaryContainer.description: Floating AI summary card; null summaryContent renders nothing.

ResetPasswordModal.description: OTP + reset password steps; async boolean gates.

EditModalContainer.description: Modal edit chat or user profile; getAdapters; Enter/Escape. Extends Omit<WrapperRootProps<'div'>, 'as'|'children'>; rest spread to Modal.

MessageLinkPreview.description: URL/document preview card; refresh handler; expandDirection up|down.

MessageInput.description: Chat composer row; requires adapters; inputTextRef typed as any in source.

EditorCodePanel.description: Editor code area with statusText line and children slot.

EditorHelperBar.description: Docs link + tooltip actions for programmable editor.

EditorLogsPanel.description: Collapsible logs panel; visible=false renders null.

EditorValidationBar.description: Validation toolbar: status, tooltip, check/save, optional children.

OtherUserProfile.description: Other user profile card/compact; start conversation, back/close.

DynamicAvatar.description: Avatar with ImageLoader, blur hash, gradient fallback.

ImageView.description: Image tile with optional click and MediaBlurHash props.

InfoBox.description: Labeled info row; optional edit and icon.

InformativeMessage.description: System/info message strip in chat list.

InteractiveDate.description: Formatted date; numeric input is Unix seconds (multiplied by 1000 internally).

MagicButton.description: AI/magic composer button; adapters; inputTextRef any.

MediaAttachment.description: Single attachment tile; exports MediaAttachmentData type.

MessageUserIcon.description: User avatar for message row with fallbacks.

SocketConnectingLine.description: Connecting banner; hidden when socket connected.

TypingLine.description: Typing indicator; getAdapters participants; TypingLineProps + internal optional fields.

VideoView.description: Video tile with blur hash and optional controls.
